card.name: Gap before a number or MAOI start
card.fires_on: Spaces or linking words right before a number or a next step: the space before a number in ranges, unit labels or study names, and the word "before" after stopping an antidepressant ahead of an MAOI.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space token just ahead of a digit in study names, ranges, grades or unit exponents.

modes.label: "before" in MAOI washout
modes.description: The word "before" after stopping an antidepressant and ahead of starting an MAOI.
